rule.status: CLEAN: no rule, gate, variant or threshold here was chosen on 2025; the books and this rule are frozen before any 2025 replay and are not changed after it
rule.trend_book: UNION_ADX holds on 2025 if its per-lot net > 0 AND it beats UNION (the same four, no gate) AND UNION_DRIVE (the book live until Oct 29) AND the median of the 20 random-entry books under the same ADX >= 25 gate
rule.sideways: FADE (and PDL_FADE) holds if its main variant (the O29i H1 pick, the one shown to the owner) nets > 0 on 2025's sideways days AND beats the median of the 20 random sideways books; the other pick is reported beside it
rule.combo: UNION_ADX + main FADE (trade lists joined; the two gates never trade the same day) against UNION_ADX alone; adding the fade can be recommended only if FADE holds AND the combo nets more than UNION_ADX alone
rule.tpb20: TPB at ADX >= 20 holds if > 0 and it beats TPB always
rule.reported: worst day, max drawdown, green / red months, halves (Jan-Jun, Jul-Dec), quarters, one-lot weeks from Rs 15,000 with the Rs 7,000 floor
rule.both_years: 2026 per lot from the stored O29f / O29g / O29i replays (in-sample, not re-scored) + 2025 = 22 months
rule.no_change: nothing in the system changes on this result; the owner decides
